thread:
Maya Gupta: Heads-up — eng is planning a breaking change in partner SDK v4: remove legacy `batch` key, require `X-Redwood-Auth: v2`. This affects marketplace connectors, SI integrations, and some hardware adapters. Need partner coordination.
Ethan Park: Timeline?
Maya Gupta: Code freeze in 18 days, 60-day deprecation window after freeze. We may offer a short compatibility adapter for on-prem.
Lian Zhou: HW partners run quarterly firmware cycles. 60 days might be tight. Can we provide a temporary adapter or a grace mode for Dedicated installs?
Ethan Park: We can ship a feature-flagged adapter that translates old `batch` envelopes to `requests` for ~45 days post-freeze and add `--compat` logging. Will publish header + payload spec in 5 business days.
Priya Kapoor: GTM needs a partner comms kit: email, FAQ, marketplace banner, and a migration checklist. Also propose an invite-only canary program. ETA 7 days for the kit once spec lands.
Maya Gupta: Action items: 1) Ethan -> header/payload spec + adapter plan (ETA 5 days). 2) Priya -> comms kit + canary signup (ETA 7 days). 3) Lian -> test plan for HW adapters and firmware schedule impact (ETA 6 days).
ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-06-10 10:00 UTC to review shim test results.
Ethan Park: quick example to include in the spec:
```
// old
{"batch":[{"input":"..."}],"model":"rwd-small"}
// new
{"requests":[{"input":"..."}],"model":"rwd-small"}
// header required
X-Redwood-Auth: v2
```
Maya Gupta: Thanks — we'll reconvene after specs and the first shim build. Flag blockers in-thread. :white_check_mark:
